citation.authors: Rutter MD, East J, Rees CJ et al

cited_by.title: Colonoscopy: when to start and how often

record.population: UK adults aged 18 and over after polyp removal or cancer surgery
record.design: Consensus guideline from BSG, ACPGBI and Public Health England
record.finding: High risk of future bowel cancer after polypectomy is two or more premalignant polyps including at least one advanced polyp, or five or more premalignant polyps; this group has a one-off surveillance colonoscopy at 3 years.
